svg.aria-label: Fernly: twelve quality dimensions drawn as leaves — two are holes nobody can measure yet
svg.title: Fernly — the two holes (derived from quality/strategy.md, 2026-06-11)
svg.desc: Poster of Fernly's twelve quality dimensions as leaves. Healthy green leaves are proven by tests or outside checks (schedule math, photo privacy). Paling, drying leaves are known gaps with work queued (backup restore, plant identification, payments, sensor pairing, support diagnosis); the daily-care feel is judged by people, deliberately. Two leaf-shaped holes — reminder delivery and household sync — mark the dimensions nobody can measure yet. The holes are exactly where users get hurt.
svg.metadata: { "project": "Fernly", "derivedFrom": "quality/strategy.md", "strategyDate": "2026-06-11", "view": "static overview poster — the two holes (twelve dimensions)", "skillVersion": "0.3.0", "legend": {"healthy": "proven by tests or an outside check", "mostly": "mostly solid", "judged-by-people": "deliberately judged by people, not scripts", "paling": "known gap, work queued", "hole": "nobody can measure it yet (strategy confidence: —)"}, "leaves": [ {"dimension": "Reminder delivery (1a)", "state": "hole", "note": "no delivery telemetry; #1 churn driver"}, {"dimension": "Household sync (4)", "state": "hole", "note": "convergence never tested"}, {"dimension": "Schedule math (1b)", "state": "healthy", "note": "property suite, 11 regressions caught"}, {"dimension": "Photo privacy (8)", "state": "healthy", "note": "pen-test clean, authz suite in CI"}, {"dimension": "Photo-backup restore (2)", "state": "paling", "note": "never rehearsed"}, {"dimension": "Plant identification (3a)", "state": "paling", "note": "'feels fine', unmeasured (conf L)"}, {"dimension": "Payments (5)", "state": "paling", "note": "edge paths unexercised"}, {"dimension": "Sensor pairing (7)", "state": "paling", "note": "31% of support load"}, {"dimension": "Support diagnosis (12)", "state": "paling", "note": "a reminder ticket costs about an hour"}, {"dimension": "Daily-care feel (Part 6, oracle-is-a-person)", "state": "judged-by-people", "note": "lived-in, unexamined; monthly charter walks planned (action I)"}, {"dimension": "Offline behaviour (6)", "state": "mostly", "note": "photo queue solid, multi-day untested"}, {"dimension": "App-store readiness (10)", "state": "mostly", "note": "crash-free 99.62%, new paywall unreviewed"} ] }
svg.text: FERNLY · A PLANT-CARE APP · ONE LEAF PER QUESTION
Fernly is a plant-care app; each leaf is one thing that matters about its quality.
The two holes sit exactly where users get hurt — the reminders and the shared lists — and nobody can yet see either fail.
deep green = proven · light green = mostly solid · pale = judged by people · drying = known gap · hole = can't measure yet
from Fernly's own quality strategy (quality/strategy.md, 2026-06-11) — the doc is the source of truth
